CustomField.formula:
IF( ISBLANK(CP_Name_Existing__c),
IF( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'PNV',
LOWER( 'PNV' & '-' & Merchant_Name__c & '-' & PNV_Code__c & '-' & SUBSTITUTE(App_Name__c, " ", "") ),
IF( AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'SID', TEXT(Type_SMS__c) = 'SMS Interaktif' ),
LOWER( "i_" & Media_Seller__r.prefix_ms__c & "_" & SUBSTITUTE(newSenderid__c, "+", "") ),
LOWER( "SMS-" &
IF( ISPICKVAL(Type_Sender__c, 'Premium'), 'P', IF( ISPICKVAL(Type_Sender__c, 'Regular'), 'R', 'C' ) ) &
"-" & Owner:User.Suffix &
IF( OR( Owner:User.Suffix = 'dws', Owner:User.Suffix = 'jts', Owner:User.Suffix = 'mcm' ), "-" & Media_Seller__r.prefix_ms__c, "" ) &
IF( TEXT(Karet__c) = 'Yes', "-krt-", "-" ) &
Kategori_Industri__r.prefix_ms__c ) ) ),
CP_Name_Existing__c )
CustomField.label: CP Name
